parameters.query:
WITH cnt AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS n FROM teachers_manager.book_chunks WHERE book_id = $1::uuid
)
UPDATE teachers_manager.book_sources b
SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'ready' AND (SELECT n FROM cnt) > 0 THEN 'ready' ELSE 'failed' END,
    error_message = CASE WHEN $2 = 'ready' AND (SELECT n FROM cnt) > 0 THEN NULL
                         ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), 'لم يتم استخراج أي نص قابل للفهرسة من هذا الملف.') END,
    page_count = NULLIF($4, '')::integer,
    chapter_count = NULLIF($5, '')::integer,
    chapters = NULLIF($6, '')::jsonb,
    is_scanned = ($7 = 'true'),
    ocr_page_count = COALESCE(NULLIF($8, '')::integer, 0),
    progress = CASE WHEN $2 = 'ready' AND (SELECT n FROM cnt) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE b.progress END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE b.id = $1::uuid AND b.teacher_id = $9::uuid
RETURNING b.id, b.status, b.error_message, b.page_count, b.chapter_count, (SELECT n FROM cnt) AS chunk_count;
